# 📽️ Cloud Misconfiguration AI — 20-Slide Project Presentation Deck

### Slide 1: Title & Introduction
* **Title:** Cloud Misconfiguration AI
* **Subtitle:** Next-Generation AI Cloud Security Engineer & Attack-Path Intelligence
* **Author:** Vijay Mahes (<Vijaypradhap2004@gmail.com>)
* **Domain:** Cloud Security / DevSecOps / AI in Cybersecurity

### Slide 2: The Core Problem in Cloud Security
* **The Scale:** 100+ daily alerts generated by traditional CSPM tools.
* **The Flaw:** Vulnerabilities are scanned in isolation without understanding connectivity.
* **Result:** Alert fatigue and high-impact breaches (e.g. Capital One, Uber).

### Slide 3: Our Solution Paradigm
* **Traditional:** "S3 bucket is publicly accessible."
* **Cloud Misconfiguration AI:** "CRITICAL — Customer database backup is publicly accessible. Exposure path: Internet ➔ Storage ➔ Database credentials ➔ Production environment."

### Slide 4: System Architecture
* Discovery Engine ➔ Multi-Vector Detection ➔ Attack-Path Synthesis ➔ Business Risk Engine ➔ AI Remediation Copilot.

### Slide 5: Mathematical Business Risk Formulation
* $\text{Risk} = T_{\text{sev}} \times A_{\text{crit}} \times D_{\text{sens}} \times E_{\text{expo}} \times X_{\text{expl}} \times B_{\text{dep}}$.

### Slide 6: Multi-Cloud Discovery & Digital Twin
* Unifies AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud topologies into a real-time graph.

### Slide 7: Interactive Attack-Path Killchain
* Multi-hop exploit graph showing attacker step-by-step traversal.

### Slide 8: AI Remediation Copilot
* 3-Step Human-in-the-Loop workflow: **Preview ➔ Approve ➔ Apply**.
* 1-Click Terraform, Cloud CLI, and IAM Policy fixes.

### Slide 9: Quantitative FAIR Monte Carlo Risk Simulator
* $ Value-at-Risk (VaR) and probabilistic annual breach loss curve.

### Slide 10: Shift-Left IaC Scanner
* Static analysis for Terraform and Kubernetes manifests before deployment.

### Slide 11: Compliance Framework Mappings
* CIS Benchmarks v3.0, NIST SP 800-53, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, PCI DSS 4.0.

### Slide 12: Live Incident Webhook Dispatcher
* Direct integration into Slack BlockKit and Discord for instant SOC alerting.

### Slide 13: Comparative Benchmark
* Superior to standalone scanners (Prowler, ScoutSuite, Security Hub).

### Slide 14: Demo Walkthrough: AWS Fintech SSRF Breach
* Step-by-step demonstration of the Capital One-style exploit path severance.

### Slide 15: Experimental Evaluation & Results
* 92% reduction in alert noise; MTTR reduced from hours to seconds.

### Slide 16: Technology Stack
* Node.js, React 19, Vite, TailwindCSS, Docker, GitHub Actions, Python SDK.

### Slide 17: Security & Safety Guardrails
* Human approval required for all production changes; no automatic breaking edits.

### Slide 18: Future Roadmap
* Autonomous cloud healing agents, eBPF runtime drift integration, GenAI fine-tuning.

### Slide 19: Conclusion
* Shifting cloud security from passive compliance audits to proactive business-risk mitigation.
